This is a GPS speedometer app that measures the speed of all modes of transport in km/h (kilometers per hour), miles per hour (mph), knots in real time.

HUD function to track vehicle speed:
HUD stands for head-up display, which is a very useful feature when you are driving at night. The HUD feature is a feature that displays a vehicle speed indicator in km/h or miles per hour on the windshield by reflecting the light from your phone. Now you can follow the road and track your speed in km/h, miles per hour or knots depending on your settings.

App features:
• Real time speed
• Simple and clear user interface (beautiful look of the vehicle speed meter)
• Distance meter / odometer (mileage meter)
• HUD function
• Speed ​​limit warning
• Travel history and statistics
• Save your travel map in history
• Calculate the cost of the trip
• Choice of the currency of the cost of the trip
• Support for 6 speedometer resolutions
• Support 8 speed limit permissions
• Support for 3 speed units (km/h, mph, knots)
• Support for 3 units of distance (km, mile, nautical mile)

You need a subscription to use all features.
